verdict.rationale: Fenwick's Startup Resource Center explicitly addresses 'Incorporation Stage Issues,' its Startup & VC practice claims 1,500+ VC-backed clients, and Fenwick Labs touts 'automated generation of incorporation documents for new startups,' confirming incorporation is a core, technology-supported service of its startup practice. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming charter/bylaws/board consent/founder stock purchase deliverables specifically, and independent client corroboration of the incorporation workflow.
